head: a73df5e9c8aaafb81be810326ef9ed19a3dec682
purpose: Model sensitivity and consistency, not calibration fit or electrical causality proof
authorization_scope: Read existing captures/source; compile and execute host math; no hardware, no production edits

assumptions.rref_ohm: 10000 in each accepted frame header; actual resistor not independently measured here
assumptions.internal_reference_span_uv: 2500000 from vexc-avss in every accepted frame; actual REFOUT-AVSS not independently measured here
assumptions.path_offset_basis: sdkconfig default=0; EngineInit bank/cell offsets zero; both raw captures CAL source=0,valid=0. No offset fit.
assumptions.aincom: Production midpoint estimate, not independent AINCOM measurement
assumptions.raw_adc: No valid per-cell raw ADC/CELL samples in either capture. inferred_differential_uv is algebraically inverted from already-converted R, never a fabricated raw ADC code.

formula.simplified_zero_offset: R = Rref * (E/(differential + span/2) - 1), apart from integer midpoint rounding
formula.span_sensitivity_near_10k: dR/dSpan = -Rref*E/(2*(differential+span/2)^2); approximately -0.008 ohm/uV near a 10k/10k divider at E=2.5V

user_dmm_report.bounds: Conservative corner arithmetic; no probability model, synchronization or <10mV fluctuation claim

S1D1.note: Descriptive capture comparison only; segmented values retained; no calibration coefficient fit

S8D8.note: Descriptive capture comparison only; segmented values retained; no calibration coefficient fit

S1D1.note: Descriptive capture comparison only; segmented values retained; no calibration coefficient fit

S8D8.note: Descriptive capture comparison only; segmented values retained; no calibration coefficient fit

S1D1.caution: Different capture times; inferred differential is algebraic, not raw ADC or a simultaneous physical voltage measurement.

S8D8.caution: Different capture times; inferred differential is algebraic, not raw ADC or a simultaneous physical voltage measurement.

limits: No independent resistor, REFOUT-AVSS or AINCOM measurements in these captures.
DMM AVDD range is not a synchronized time series and does not establish <10mV ripple.
External split changes cannot determine which displayed resistance is true.
No offset inferred or applied; no production source edited; raw recordings unchanged.
ADC CRC failures are a separate integrity issue; rail-model arithmetic cannot explain or fix them.
next_localization: In a single stable RES configuration/window, retain actual CELL?=S1D1 and CELL?=S8D8 snapshots with valid=1,fresh=1,error=NONE and their seq; correlate against frame header/CRC/identity. CELL vref is matrixReferenceUv (ground-referenced excitation), not ADC reference span.
Measure AVDD, AVSS, AINCOM and REFOUT with timestamps in the same mode; compute actual AINCOM-AVSS and REFOUT-AVSS, preserving instrument uncertainty.
Offline recompute actual raw-code differential using recorded gain and reference assumptions, then actual measured voltage differences; retain both original stream and calculated values.
Investigate physical SPI integrity separately; do not adjust resistance offset to compensate CRC failures or assumed rail ripple.

fixed_d_dmm_boundary_sensitivity.basis: Hold each cell at the median model-inverted differential from the internal-rail capture; these are not measured raw ADC samples.
fixed_d_dmm_boundary_sensitivity.endpoints: Independent AVDD/AVSS endpoint combinations from the user report; not synchronized measurements, not a statistical uncertainty/confidence interval.
